title: Synthetic fixture and discovery for Cursor IDE and agent stores
description: Fixture mirrors the Cursor User dir (state.vscdb composer stores with per-workspace and central indexes) and the ~/.cursor agent transcripts and chats metadata. Done when: discovery unions all composer indexes and finds agent sessions.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Synthetic Cursor fixtures + BDD: state.vscdb cursorDiskKV KV store drives composer discovery from composerHeaders (3 composers -> 3 sessions); CLI agent transcripts discovered per project dir under agent-transcripts/. CursorSource (KV) and CursorCliSource (transcripts) in src/adapters/cursor.rs; fixture steps in tests/steps/cursor_steps.rs. Full gate green (bdd 101/101).

right_now_summary: Work is focused on finding Cursor composer stores and agent sessions across workspace and central indexes.
